snippet.title: Tower of Titans (VR Action RPG) Coming Soon Trailer
snippet.description:
Blast, conjure, loot and craft your way to becoming the ultimate master of magic in Tower of Titans. A new VR Action RPG coming in 2025 for Meta Quest!

Feel the mana course through your fingertips as you conjure deadly magic using your bare hands. Grow ever more powerful on a path of your own choosing as you discover great rings and master new skills. Ready yourself for the moment when you face the Titans and uncover the secret behind your identity.

Visit us on Meta Quest Store: https://www.meta.com/experiences/tower-of-titans/6482355435205102
